DDL to be executed:
--------------------------------------------------

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS time_diff(timerange);

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS windows CASCADE;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS shifts CASCADE;

DROP TYPE IF EXISTS z_span RESTRICT;

DROP TYPE IF EXISTS timerange RESTRICT;

DROP TYPE IF EXISTS span_table RESTRICT;

DROP TYPE IF EXISTS span_subtype RESTRICT;

DROP TYPE IF EXISTS span_loses RESTRICT;

DROP TYPE IF EXISTS span_gains RESTRICT;

DROP TYPE IF EXISTS positive_span RESTRICT;

DROP DOMAIN IF EXISTS band_set RESTRICT;

DROP TYPE IF EXISTS band RESTRICT;

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS z_diff(integer, integer);

DROP TYPE IF EXISTS a_span RESTRICT;

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS time_diff(time without time zone, time without time zone);

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS severity_diff(severity, severity);

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS severity_num(severity);

DROP TYPE IF EXISTS severity RESTRICT;

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS positive_diff(positive, positive);

DROP DOMAIN IF EXISTS positive RESTRICT;

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS old_diff(integer, integer);

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS is_positive(integer);

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS a_diff(integer, integer);

DROP TYPE IF EXISTS z_status RESTRICT;

CREATE TYPE floatrange AS RANGE (
    subtype = double precision
);

CREATE TYPE level AS ENUM (
    'low',
    'medium',
    'high'
);

CREATE TYPE level_band AS RANGE (
    subtype = level
);

CREATE TYPE period AS RANGE (
    subtype = date
);

CREATE DOMAIN availability AS period_multirange;

CREATE TYPE booking AS (room integer, slot period);

CREATE TYPE pricerange AS RANGE (
    subtype = numeric
);

CREATE TYPE span AS RANGE (
    subtype = integer
);

CREATE TYPE span_loses AS RANGE (
    subtype = bigint
);

CREATE TYPE span_subtype AS RANGE (
    subtype = bigint
);

CREATE TYPE span_table AS RANGE (
    subtype = bigint
);

CREATE TYPE textrange AS RANGE (
    subtype = text,
    multirange_type_name = textspans,
    subtype_opclass = pg_catalog.text_pattern_ops,
    collation = "C"
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reservations (
    id integer,
    during floatrange,
    gaps floatmultirange,
    CONSTRAINT reservations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT reservations_during_excl EXCLUDE USING gist (during WITH &&)
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION new_diff(
    x integer,
    y integer
)
RETURNS double precision
LANGUAGE sql
IMMUTABLE
STRICT
AS $$SELECT (x - y)::double precision
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ts_diff(
    x timestamp,
    y timestamp
)
RETURNS double precision
LANGUAGE sql
IMMUTABLE
STRICT
AS $$SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (x - y))
$$;

CREATE TYPE span_gains AS RANGE (
    subtype = integer,
    subtype_diff = new_diff
);

CREATE TYPE stamp_span AS RANGE (
    subtype = timestamp without time zone,
    subtype_diff = ts_diff
);

CREATE DOMAIN break_set AS stamp_span_multirange;

CREATE TYPE shift_slot AS (room integer, during stamp_span);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stamps (
    id integer,
    during stamp_span,
    breaks stamp_span_multirange,
    history stamp_span[],
    past_breaks stamp_span_multirange[],
    CONSTRAINT stamps_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION stamp_length(
    r stamp_span
)
RETURNS double precision
LANGUAGE sql
IMMUTABLE
STRICT
AS $$SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (upper(r) - lower(r)))
$$;

GRANT USAGE ON TYPE floatrange TO app_role;
